label: DM composition census - previously unclaimed assets, explicitly held
description: The accept-r4 tokenconfig_sweep proved the v1 matrices stale against the chain universe: the provider priced eleven assets no scenario named, so every stress run held their TVL flat BY OMISSION (oracle-sentinel R4's named failure). The adjudicated principle is that absent-claim-by-omission is the defect and explicit-claim-or-explicit-decision is the fix. This scenario is that record: every previously unclaimed configured DM asset gets a propagation row whose composition (base_asset, stable flags, axis) is derived mechanically from PriceProviderV2.tokenConfig at the accept-r4 OP pin, and every axis it introduces is shocked by the EXPLICIT factor 1/1 - the disclosed decision to hold each mark, chosen over an invented stress magnitude. weEUR carries no axis of its own: it composes under EURC (a NON-stable base, so no snap) and responds to EURC's axis linearly.
path_assumption: no move is asserted: every shock in this census is the explicit factor 1/1, so each named mark is held at its current sample BY DECISION, disclosed in the applied-shock record rather than in the held-flat list

out_of_model: stress magnitudes for the census assets: NO shock is asserted for liquidRWA, OP, eUSD, beHYPE, WHYPE, EURC, weEUR or either liquidRESERVE - the 1/1 factors are the explicit, disclosed decision to hold each mark, adjudicated preferable to an invented magnitude (accept-r4: explicit-claim-or-explicit-decision closes the omission defect; a sized shock for any of these is future scenario work, not a default)

JUDGMENT (flagged, conservative): beHYPE and WHYPE are economically HYPE-linked, but PriceProviderV2 declares NO shared base for them at the pin (each carries its own push oracle, baseAsset=0x0), so each gets its OWN axis and no joint HYPE/USD axis is claimed - the correlation judgment is recorded here instead of invented

JUDGMENT (flagged, conservative): eUSD and EURC are claimed exactly as the chain declares them (isStableToken=false, so NEITHER joins the stable_snap set); if governance later flips either to isStableToken, the stable-set weld will catch the drift in both directions (risk-quant R4.1)
EUR/USD market risk: EURC's axis is effectively EUR/USD and weEUR composes over it; no EUR scenario is asserted

the two liquidRESERVE deployments share one symbol and one oracle but are DISTINCT tokens; every claim and every axis instance here is keyed by ADDRESS, never symbol (the twin hazard recorded in the accept-r4 adjudication)
liquidRWA is marked by a push feed with maxStaleness 604800 (7 days) at the pin; RWA marking latency and NAV-vs-market divergence are not modeled

per-asset base_asset claims are the DEPLOYED composition graph read from PriceProviderV2.tokenConfig(token).baseAsset at the accept-r4 OP pin (block 154938071, hash 0xaf91dd4ba1975fc3b93e411586ce267892406ed8cb7152c5cefe1c368696c6bc, provider 0x44dd2372FE7B97C4B4D6a7d4DeCf72466485BAcB) - a hash-pinned SAMPLE with no continuity claim (chain-truth R3.1), fixture-welded in internal/risk/testdata/tokenconfig_accept_r4.json
oracle lag and heartbeat behaviour: the census holds marks at their current sample; the real feeds update on deviation or heartbeat
